connect.title: Capture decisions automatically
connect.body: Connect Google Meet and Corteza reads each meeting’s transcript or Gemini notes, then saves the decisions and action items for you. Nobody has to write anything down.
connect.step2: Turn on transcription or Gemini “Take notes for me” in your meetings
connect.step3: Decisions show up here a few minutes after each meeting

import.background: It keeps going in the background. We’ll email you a summary when it’s done.
import.finished: Import finished. Your overview is up to date.

capture.noMeetings: No meetings processed yet. After your next Google Meet with transcription or Gemini notes on, it shows up here within a few minutes. You can also import past meetings.

onboarding.body1: Corteza reads the transcripts and Gemini notes of your Google Meet meetings and saves what matters:
onboarding.item1: Decisions, with the reason behind them
onboarding.item2: Action items, with owner and due date
onboarding.tip1: Turn on transcripts or Gemini’s “Take notes for me” in your meetings. Outcomes of your meetings are private to you.
onboarding.body2: Ask in your own words about any meeting. Corteza answers and shows the outcomes it used, so you can check the source.
onboarding.q1: What did we decide about pricing?
onboarding.q2: What are my open action items?
onboarding.q3: Why did we choose this plan?
onboarding.body3: Every commitment from your meetings lands in Action items, with who owns it and when it’s due.
onboarding.item4: No due date? Corteza emails the owner to set one
onboarding.item5: Mark items done as you go, or change the date
onboarding.item6: Filter to yours, or see everyone’s
onboarding.body4: A short description and a glossary (acronyms, customers, people and their roles) help Corteza capture what matters to your business and spell names right.

language.title: Language
language.body: The language Corteza’s screens use. Outcomes stay in the language of each meeting.
language.label: App language

meet.intro: Corteza reads the transcripts and Gemini notes of your Google Meet meetings and saves the decisions automatically.

context.title: Context for the AI
context.intro: Corteza reads this with every meeting, so it knows what matters to your business, spells names and acronyms right (the transcript often gets “CAC” or “P&L” wrong) and knows who’s who when it assigns owners.
context.companyNote: Shared by everyone in your workspace.
context.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Acme sells billing software to small businesses in Chile and Peru. We sell monthly plans and onboarding services.
context.glossaryHelp: One term per line: acronyms, products, customers, people and their roles.
context.glossaryPlaceholder:
CAC: customer acquisition cost
P&L: profit and loss statement
José Tomás Acuña: finance
context.documentsHelp: A Google Doc, Sheet or Slides, or a TXT, MD, CSV, PDF or DOCX file: a dictionary, org chart, product list… Only the text is kept.
context.youNote: Only used for your own meetings. Colleagues don’t see it.
context.focusPlaceholder: e.g. Growth in Peru, pricing, and the finance team’s reporting.
context.yourGlossaryPlaceholder: Terms and names that come up in your meetings

summary.title: Morning summary
summary.intro: On weekdays at 8:00 AM, Corteza emails you what happened since your last summary: meetings, decisions, new action items and what’s due today. Only when there’s something new.

partner.title: Your morning partner
partner.intro: Who writes your summary. A partner opens it with a line about your day; your list stays the same.

partner.classicAbout: The plain summary: your numbers and your list.
partner.sergeantAbout: Tough love. Short, direct, no excuses.
partner.sarcasticAbout: Dry irony about your to-do list. Never about you.
